name: Cookie Policy
metaDescription: Learn about cookies and similar technologies used on the Cybersentinels Consulting website and how to manage your choices.

blocks.text: This Cookie Policy explains how [FULL LEGAL ENTITY NAME], trading as Cybersentinels Consulting, uses cookies and similar technologies on [WEBSITE DOMAIN]. It should be read with our Privacy Notice.

sections.heading: 2. What Are Cookies and Similar Technologies?

blocks.text: Cookies are small data files stored or accessed on a browser or device. Similar technologies may include local storage, pixels, tags, scripts and software-development-kit functions. These technologies can support website operation, security, preferences, measurement and other functions.

These technologies are required for functions such as security, network management, form operation, load balancing, consent storage and other services you request. They cannot always be disabled through our consent tool, but browser settings may affect them and website functionality.
These technologies remember choices such as language, region or display preferences. [REMOVE THIS CATEGORY IF NOT USED.]
These technologies help us understand website use and performance. Where required, we will activate them only after consent. [INSERT ACTUAL ANALYTICS PROVIDERS AND CONFIGURATION OR REMOVE.]
These technologies may measure campaigns or support advertising across services. [REMOVE THIS CATEGORY UNLESS ACTUALLY USED, APPROVED AND ACCURATELY DISCLOSED.]

Videos, maps, scheduling widgets, chat tools, social features or other embedded services may set or access technologies. [LIST EACH ACTUAL EMBED AND ENSURE IT IS BLOCKED UNTIL CONSENT WHERE REQUIRED.]

When required, optional technologies will remain disabled until you make a choice. The website should provide equally visible options to accept or reject optional categories and a way to adjust choices later.

items: Open Cookie Settings: [LINK OR BUTTON LABEL]
Withdraw or change consent at any time through the persistent Cookie Settings control
Use browser controls to delete or block cookies
Review provider opt-out tools where relevant

blocks.text: Blocking strictly necessary technologies may prevent parts of the website from functioning. Browser-based signals such as Global Privacy Control or Do Not Track will be handled as required by applicable law and the website’s implemented configuration. [COUNSEL AND DEVELOPER TO CONFIRM.]
The final website must publish an accurate inventory using the following fields:

Session technologies expire when the relevant session ends. Persistent technologies remain for their stated duration unless deleted earlier. Consent choices should be requested again when legally required, when purposes or providers materially change, or after [CONSENT RENEWAL PERIOD].

We may update this policy when technologies, providers, purposes or legal requirements change. The “Last updated” date shows the most recent revision. Material changes may require a new consent choice.
Questions about this policy may be sent to [PRIVACY EMAIL ADDRESS] or [OFFICIAL OFFICE ADDRESS].
